messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R Group Tomorrow, Zoom Only
messages.body_plain:
As I'm still recovering from COVID (my isolation is ended, but I'm staying home this week in an abundance of caution) the R Group tomorrow (Feb 16) will be Zoom only.

https://fsu.zoom.us/my/ralmond

Starting somewhere around noon.

We will go over a lecture I did in my data analysis class about the common R commands I use to generate data for test cases (and simulation studies).

    --Russell


--
Russell Almond
Associate Professor, Measurement & Statistics
Educational Psychology and Learning Systems
College of Education, Health, and Human Sciences
1114 W. Call St.
Florida State University
Tallahassee, FL 32306
ralmond at fsu.edu<mailto:ralmond at fsu.edu>
http://ralmond.net/
Appointment calendar: https://doodle.com/bp/russellalmond/book-a-time

messages.subject: [Epls-r-users] R group this Friday!
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone!

The R group will be meeting this Friday, in Stone Building room 3203 (or Zoom: https://fsu.zoom.us/j/98450885843) at noon. This week, Dr. Almond will be covering Monte Carlo methods in R.

If you need access to the R group canvas site, you can join here:

https://canvas.fsu.edu/enroll/AWFYCW

Hope to see many of you this Friday!




Kari Roberts

Director of Strategic Planning and Assessment

Division of Student Affairs

Florida State University

313 Westcott Building

Tallahassee, FL 32306-1340
